name: gdpr-data-map-check
description: GDPR compliance data map check: reads a CSV or JSON data map or record of processing activities that lists personal data fields with their system, category, purpose, lawful basis, Article 9 condition, retention, processor, location, transfer safeguard and owner, and reports fields with no purpose or lawful basis, special category data with no Article 9 condition, criminal offence data, missing or open-ended retention, transfers out of the EU/EEA with no safeguard, processors with no agreement, missing owners and duplicate rows, with a summary per system. Text, JSON, CSV and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies. An engineering aid, not legal advice.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
